-- 3-2. 전체 사용자 대상 1시간 전 푸시 알림 발송 대상 추출 쿼리
-- (오늘 대상 요일 + 미완료 루틴 + 목표 시각 55~65분 전 배치 스케줄러용)
SELECT 
    u.user_id,
    u.username,
    r.routine_id,
    r.title AS routine_title,
    s.target_time AS 알림_목표_시간,
    TO_CHAR(s.target_time, 'HH24:MI') AS formatted_target_time
FROM routine_schedules s
JOIN routines r ON r.routine_id = s.routine_id
JOIN users u ON u.user_id = r.user_id
LEFT JOIN routine_logs rl 
       ON rl.routine_id = r.routine_id 
      AND rl.log_date = CURRENT_DATE
WHERE s.day_of_week = EXTRACT(DOW FROM CURRENT_DATE)
  AND rl.log_id IS NULL -- 미완료된 루틴만 발송
  AND s.target_time BETWEEN (CURRENT_TIME + INTERVAL '55 minutes')::TIME 
                        AND (CURRENT_TIME + INTERVAL '65 minutes')::TIME;

SELECT 
    r.routine_id,
    r.title AS routine_title,
    s.target_time AS scheduled_time,
    r.current_streak AS 현재_스트릭,
    (rl.log_id IS NOT NULL) AS is_completed,
    rl.completed_at AS 완료_시각
FROM routines r
JOIN routine_schedules s ON s.routine_id = r.routine_id
LEFT JOIN routine_logs rl 
       ON rl.routine_id = r.routine_id 
      AND rl.log_date = CURRENT_DATE
WHERE r.user_id = 1
  AND s.day_of_week = EXTRACT(DOW FROM CURRENT_DATE)
ORDER BY s.target_time ASC;

SELECT 
    u.user_id,
    u.username,
    r.routine_id,
    r.title AS routine_title,
    s.target_time AS 알림_목표_시간,
    TO_CHAR(s.target_time, 'HH24:MI') AS formatted_target_time
FROM routine_schedules s
JOIN routines r ON r.routine_id = s.routine_id
JOIN users u ON u.user_id = r.user_id
LEFT JOIN routine_logs rl 
       ON rl.routine_id = r.routine_id 
      AND rl.log_date = CURRENT_DATE
WHERE s.day_of_week = EXTRACT(DOW FROM CURRENT_DATE)
  AND rl.log_id IS NULL -- 미완료된 루틴만 발송
  AND s.target_time BETWEEN (CURRENT_TIME + INTERVAL '55 minutes')::TIME 
                        AND (CURRENT_TIME + INTERVAL '65 minutes')::TIME;

SELECT board_id, title, writer_id, created_at
FROM public.board
WHERE category_id = 1
  AND is_deleted = false
  AND created_at >= '2026-08-01 00:00:00'
  AND created_at < '2026-08-05 00:00:00'
ORDER BY board_id DESC

SELECT board_id, title, writer_id, created_at
FROM public.board

  AND created_at >= '2026-08-01 00:00:00'
  AND created_at < '2026-08-05 00:00:00'
ORDER BY board_id DESC
LIMIT 20;
